subject: The 3AM feature you haven't seen yet
preview_text: We added something for those late nights when your mind won't shut up about your ex. It's waiting for you.
body_paragraphs: It's 3AM. Your phone lights up, and for a second, you think it's them. But it's not. It's just the ceiling staring back at you, and your brain running the same loop of old texts and what-ifs. I know that feeling because I've been there. So we built something for exactly that moment.

A few weeks ago, we rolled out a new mode inside the app—something we call Emergency Mode. It's not a feature you'd notice if you just opened the app during the day. But at 3AM, when you're spiraling and need someone to talk to right then, it's there. It short-circuits the obsessive thoughts and gives you a custom coping strategy based on your breakup type, in under 30 seconds. No sign-up, no searching. Just relief.

Here's the thing: most users who try it once come back for a second time within a week. They tell us it turns a 3AM spiral into a 15-minute reset. And since you already have the app, it's waiting for you. You just need to open it and look for the moon icon at the bottom of the home screen.

Open Fresh Start right now, tap the moon icon, and try Emergency Mode for 60 seconds. That's it. One minute. P.S. The average user who does this reports feeling 40% calmer afterward. That's not a stat I made up—it's from our data.
